title: Quick Replacement of Z-Axis Cable Carrier (Snap Apart/Ends Snap-In)
summary: Performs a quick Z-axis cable carrier replacement by LOTO the tipper, snapping the carrier apart at both ends, removing the old carrier, installing the new carrier, snapping cross bars closed, and snapping both ends into the end pieces that remain mounted.
when_to_use: Use when both ends of the existing Z-axis cable carrier are in good condition and you need a quick replacement by snapping the carrier apart at both ends, leaving the end pieces mounted on the tipper.
not_for: Do not use this quick replacement method if either end of the existing carrier is not in good condition (the procedure is explicitly a quick replacement only when both ends are good).
Do not proceed if LOTO cannot be completed safely or if access to the motor/side panel is unclear.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform LOTO on the tipper and execute the physical cable carrier replacement steps (side panel removal if necessary, snap-apart/snap-in actions, and reassembly).
safety_notes: Perform LOTO on the tipper before removing the side panel or disassembling the cable carrier.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper and station side panel

system_preconditions: Both ends of the existing Z-axis cable carrier are in good condition (required for quick replacement).

visual_references.description: End stop assembly diagram (shows end stop mounting hardware and supports the concept of end pieces remaining mounted on the tipper).

steps.title: LOTO the tipper
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is locked out/tagged out before any disassembly or access to the motor/side panel.
steps.instruction: Perform LOTO on the tipper using the manual’s referenced “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” location.
steps.expected_result: The tipper is in a locked-out/tagged-out state prior to side panel removal or carrier disassembly.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is completed before proceeding to remove the station side panel or snap apart the cable carrier.
steps.failure_condition: Proceeding without completing LOTO, or inability to complete LOTO safely.

actions.label: Apply LOTO to tipper
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: If LOTO cannot be completed safely, escalate to site/maintenance support before proceeding.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: 7.3.16.2 QUICK REPLACEMENT A quick replacement can be performed if both ends of the carrier are in good condition. 1. LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

steps.title: Remove station side panel (if necessary) to access the motor
steps.purpose: Provide access to the motor area so the cable carrier can be snapped apart and replaced.
steps.instruction: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws for the station side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: The station side panel is removed and the motor access area is available.
steps.healthy_condition: All nine (9) self-tapping securing screws are removed and the side panel is removed cleanly to expose the motor area.
steps.failure_condition: Side panel cannot be removed due to unclear access, missing/incorrect fasteners, or unsafe conditions.

actions.label: Remove nine side panel screws
actions.exact_action: use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

stop_or_escalate_if: If access to the motor/side panel is unclear, escalate to site/maintenance support before proceeding.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: 2. If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

steps.title: Snap apart the old cable carrier at both ends (leave end pieces attached)
steps.purpose: Remove the old carrier while keeping the end pieces mounted on the tipper.
steps.instruction: Disassemble or “snap apart” the cable carrier at both ends, leaving only the end pieces attached to the tipper.
steps.expected_result: The old cable carrier is separated at both ends, with only the end pieces remaining attached to the tipper.
steps.healthy_condition: End pieces remain attached to the tipper while the carrier is fully separated at both ends.
steps.failure_condition: Carrier ends cannot be snapped apart cleanly, or end pieces detach unintentionally.

actions.label: Snap apart carrier at both ends
actions.exact_action: Disassemble or “snap apart” the cable carrier at both ends, leaving only the end pieces attached to the tipper.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check alignment if the new carrier cannot be snapped fully into the end pieces or if cross bars do not fully close.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: 3. Disassemble or “snap apart” the cable carrier at both ends, leaving only the end pieces attached to the tipper.

steps.title: Snap ends off the new carrier and open cross bars on the outside of the new carrier
steps.purpose: Prepare the new carrier so it can be installed and then snapped into the existing end pieces.
steps.instruction: “Snap” the ends off the new cable carrier and open all the cross bars on the outside of the new cable carrier.
steps.expected_result: The new carrier’s ends are snapped off, and all outside cross bars are open.
steps.healthy_condition: All outside cross bars are open on the new carrier and the ends are separated from the new carrier.
steps.failure_condition: Cross bars do not open fully or ends cannot be snapped off.

actions.label: Prepare new carrier
actions.exact_action: “Snap” the ends off the new cable carrier and open all the cross bars on the outside of the new cable carrier.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check alignment if the new carrier cannot be snapped fully into the end pieces or if cross bars do not fully close.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: 4. "Snap” the ends off the new cable carrier and open all the cross bars on the outside of the new cable carrier.

steps.title: Open cross bars on the old carrier and remove it from the system
steps.purpose: Clear the old carrier from the system after it has been snapped apart.
steps.instruction: Open all the cross bars on the outside of the old cable carrier and remove it from the system.
steps.expected_result: The old cable carrier is removed from the system.
steps.healthy_condition: All outside cross bars on the old carrier are open and the carrier is fully removed.
steps.failure_condition: Old carrier cannot be removed or cross bars remain closed.

actions.label: Remove old carrier
actions.exact_action: Open all the cross bars on the outside of the old cable carrier and remove it from the system.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: 5. Open all the cross bars on the outside of the old cable carrier and remove it from the system.

steps.title: Position the new carrier roughly in place with internal dividers against the air line
steps.purpose: Ensure correct internal divider placement before snapping cross bars closed and snapping ends into end pieces.
steps.instruction: Put the new cable carrier roughly in place while positioning the internal dividers all the way to one side, against the air line.
steps.expected_result: New carrier is positioned roughly in place and internal dividers are all the way to one side against the air line.
steps.healthy_condition: Internal dividers are positioned against the air line (all the way to one side).
steps.failure_condition: Internal dividers are not against the air line or carrier alignment prevents later snapping.

actions.label: Roughly position new carrier
actions.exact_action: Put the new cable carrier roughly in place while positioning the internal dividers all the way to one side, against the air line.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check alignment if the new carrier cannot be snapped fully into the end pieces or if cross bars do not fully close.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: 6. Put the new cable carrier roughly in place while positioning the internal dividers all the way to one side, against the air line.

steps.title: Snap all outside cross bars closed
steps.purpose: Secure the new carrier structure by closing all outside cross bars.
steps.expected_result: All outside cross bars on the new carrier are snapped closed.
steps.healthy_condition: Every outside cross bar is fully closed (snapped in).
steps.failure_condition: One or more cross bars do not fully close.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check alignment if the new carrier cannot be snapped fully into the end pieces or if cross bars do not fully close.

steps.title: Snap both ends into the end pieces still mounted on the tipper
steps.purpose: Complete installation by snapping the carrier ends into the existing end pieces.
steps.instruction: “Snap” both ends into the end pieces that are still mounted.
steps.expected_result: Both ends of the new carrier are snapped into the end pieces that remain mounted on the tipper.
steps.healthy_condition: Both ends are fully seated in the end pieces (snapped in).
steps.failure_condition: New carrier ends cannot be snapped fully into the end pieces.

actions.label: Snap ends into end pieces
actions.exact_action: “Snap” both ends into the end pieces that are still mounted.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check alignment if the new carrier cannot be snapped fully into the end pieces or if cross bars do not fully close.
If LOTO cannot be completed safely or access to the motor/side panel is unclear, escalate to site/maintenance support before proceeding.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: 8. “Snap” both ends into the end pieces that are still mounted.

success_criteria: New Z-axis cable carrier is installed with all outside cross bars snapped closed.
Both ends of the new carrier are snapped into the end pieces that remain mounted on the tipper.
Internal dividers are positioned all the way to one side against the air line.
healthy_conditions: All outside cross bars are fully closed (snapped).
Both ends are fully seated in the end pieces still mounted on the tipper.
Internal dividers are positioned against the air line (all the way to one side).
failure_conditions: New carrier cannot be snapped fully into the end pieces.
Cross bars do not fully close.
Access to the motor/side panel is unclear.
escalation_guidance: If LOTO cannot be completed safely or access to the motor/side panel is unclear, escalate to site/maintenance support before proceeding.
